name: BetterGov PH
desc: BetterGov PH is an open source project to build a better national website for the Philippines, live at bettergov.ph.

p: The repo's own description is "Building a better Philippines' national website". The site is at bettergov.ph, and the bettergovph organization on GitHub hosts a long list of other civic data projects beside it.

I forked the project on July 30, 2026. On the same day I committed to a branch called feature/acronym-tooltip, with two commits: "feat: add government acronym tooltip wrapper" and "feat: expand acronym dictionary with exhaustive list". The idea is a small component that wraps Philippine government acronyms in a tooltip that spells them out.
[Upstream PR number and its current status.] I couldn't read the upstream repo through GitHub when I checked on October 19, 2026, so I can't confirm a pull request or its state from here.
